about: I’m a Full Stack Java Developer with 3 years and 5 months of experience building and modernizing enterprise financial applications using Java, Spring Boot, Angular, and relational databases. I enjoy developing end-to-end solutions, integrating third-party systems, automating business workflows, and improving application performance.
currently_looking_for: Full Stack Java Developer, Java Backend Developer, Spring Boot Developer, Angular Developer, and enterprise application development roles.

experience.description: Full-stack engineering across enterprise financial management, payment gateway integration, billing automation, ticket management, and legacy application modernization using Java, Spring Boot, Angular, MySQL, and MSSQL.

work.description: Developed a full-stack financial management system for retail operations using Java 17, Spring Boot, Angular 14, and MySQL. Designed and implemented modules including Trial Balance, Vendor Purchase, Book Stock, and Expense Management. Integrated Tally and SAP systems for financial reconciliation and reporting. Improved accounting accuracy by 30%, reduced manual errors by 40%, and saved approximately 60 hours per month through automated workflows and validation processes.

Enhanced a web-based billing and payment platform using Angular 16 and Spring Boot. Integrated the HDFC payment gateway for secure online transaction processing, implemented dynamic PDF generation, and developed customized client-specific payment workflows. Redesigned more than 15 UI components using Angular Material, improving usability and increasing customer engagement by 35%.

Built a Java and Spring Boot workflow automation service for managing defects, enhancements, and support tickets throughout the software development lifecycle. Automated ticket creation, assignment, development, QA validation, and delivery with role-based status updates. Implemented real-time tracking to improve visibility across teams and streamlined coordination between development and QA.

work.workname: Legacy Application Modernization (.NET to Java Migration)
work.description: Led the migration of legacy desktop application modules from .NET to Java to improve maintainability and scalability. Re-engineered business logic, implemented OTP-based authentication, and optimized database interactions using MSSQL and JPA. Improved application response times by approximately 25% while maintaining backward compatibility and achieving 99.9% system uptime during the transition.
